goal: Prefer eligible non-Grok reviewers, including Linux-supported StepFun, while keeping Grok available when the preferred pool cannot take an exact review
dispatcher: Codex chat for owner request on 2026-09-27
prohibited_actions: do not touch migrations or database objects
do not retire Grok or bypass eligibility, independence, exact-head, or verdict safeguards
do not edit another session's branch, worktree, or evidence
assumptions: The source branch starts at the unmerged StepFun rotation pull request #3556; this pull request targets that branch until #3556 lands on main
A discarded prototype of this preference policy exists on a separate branch; this contract is published before any implementation changes on the current branch
stop_conditions: stop if StepFun's roster identity or governed capability changes upstream
stop if the policy requires a file outside allowed_paths
